_about: Smart search (card G): one joint model for free text + photo + glaze formula (multimodal_experiments/mm/glaze_joint.py). Restart RUN_GLAZE_SEARCH.bat after a change.
_model_dir: written by scripts/train_glaze_joint.py (INSTALL_GLAZE_MODEL.bat runs it); relative = project folder
_weights: weight of each part of a query; only the parts a query has are used, then renormalised to sum 1
_max_per_family: Explore formulations: at most this many recipes per K-Means family of the joint space
